description: LM-508: PriceProto bid / ask / mid. Shared by the Java PriceBidAskTest, Python test_price_bid_ask, JS Price.bidAsk.test and Rust price_bid_ask_test. Decimal values are canonical plain strings: no exponent, trailing zeros kept, e.g. 100.0 not 1E+2. Compare them with Java toPlainString(), Python format(d, 'f'), JS toCanonicalString / Decimal.toFixed() and Rust Decimal::to_string(). An absent mid / bid / ask key means the field is unset. kind is the wrapper-only PriceKind: MID, DERIVED_MID, BID or ASK.

legacy.source: PriceProto bytes written by the release before LM-508 (main at c020a98949e7b79a48d7b8a87ed19b464a2b87d8, ledger-models-python price_pb2): stamp(PriceProto(uuid, as_of, price=99.5, security, price_type=PERCENTAGE), OBJECT_TYPE_PRICE).SerializeToString().hex(). Field 10 was named price then. Never regenerate this from the current bindings.
